purpose: Machine-readable enumeration of EVERY verdict state the two accepted frozen-bar gates emit, with the exact accepted predicate and an explicit certifies / does_not_certify block, so a Product packet-admission consumer cannot misread a state. NO threshold, bar, rubric, lineage rule or incumbent value is invented or changed here: every predicate is a literal restatement of the accepted evaluation/frozen_bars/label_gate.py, evaluation/frozen_bars/geometry_gate.py and evaluation/frozen_bars/run_bar_gates.py code as accepted in cycle 38971202786.

states.LABEL_SOUND: n_scored > 0 and n_supported == n_scored (every scored counter row is supported under the frozen rubric)

certifies.LABEL_SOUND: every scored counter row on THIS packet carries evidence the frozen rubric accepts
certifies.LABEL_UNSOUND: at least one scored counter row on THIS packet fails the frozen rubric

absolute_status.does_not_certify: either state says nothing about map geometry, retrieval recall or jurist usefulness; LABEL_UNSOUND is REPORTED, never a build blocker (direction v50)

regression_verdict.predicate: lineage := (set(per_bundle) == {de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica}) AND (n_scored == 65); FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND n_supported < 5; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND NOT FAIL; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage

states.FAIL_REGRESSION: counter-label support on the incumbent population fell below the accepted 5/65
states.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: counter-label support on the incumbent population is at or above the accepted 5/65
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: the packet is not the incumbent population (different qid set, or a scored-row count other than 65); the frozen incumbent comparison does not apply

certifies.FAIL_REGRESSION: a build-blocking regression on the served-packet lineage
certifies.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: no regression on the served-packet lineage only
certifies.NOT_APPLICABLE: NOTHING about label soundness. It is an inapplicability marker, not a pass.

does_not_certify.NOT_APPLICABLE: NOT_APPLICABLE does NOT certify that counter-label support met any bar. A packet whose scored support collapsed to 0 outside the 65-row population still reports NOT_APPLICABLE with gate_blocks_build=false. Absolute status (LABEL_SOUND/UNSOUND) is the only label statement the gate makes about such a packet, and it is never enforced as a build blocker.
does_not_certify.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: does not certify the absolute bar (support_rate 1.0); the accepted served packet itself passes regression at 5/65 and is LABEL_UNSOUND

label_gate.gate_blocks_build: lineage AND n_supported < 5. Equal to regression_verdict == FAIL_REGRESSION. gate_blocks_build == false is NOT a statement that the label bar was met.

states.GEOMETRY_SOUND: every bundle passes all 11 frozen minimum-semantics criteria

certifies.GEOMETRY_SOUND: all 11 criteria pass on every scored bundle
certifies.GEOMETRY_UNSOUND: at least one criterion fails on at least one bundle

absolute_status.does_not_certify: either state says nothing about counter-label support or jurist usefulness; GEOMETRY_UNSOUND is REPORTED, never a build blocker (direction v50)

regression_verdict.predicate: lineage := (set(per_bundle) == the three incumbent qids)  [no population pin]; regressed_qids := [qid in per_bundle where lineage AND n_pass < incumbent_count(qid)]; FAIL_REGRESSION := lineage AND regressed_qids non-empty; PASS_NO_REGRESSION := lineage AND empty; NOT_APPLICABLE := NOT lineage

states.FAIL_REGRESSION: at least one bundle's criterion-count fell below its accepted incumbent (de 6 / fr 5 / it 5)
states.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: no bundle fell below its accepted incumbent criterion-count
states.NOT_APPLICABLE: the qid set is not the incumbent set; the frozen incumbent comparison does not apply

certifies.FAIL_REGRESSION: a build-blocking geometry regression on the three frozen qids
certifies.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: no criterion-count regression on the three frozen qids
certifies.NOT_APPLICABLE: NOTHING about geometry semantics; inapplicability marker

does_not_certify.PASS_NO_REGRESSION: does not certify the absolute 11/11 bar (accepted served bundles pass regression at 6/5/5 and are GEOMETRY_UNSOUND)

geometry_gate.gate_blocks_build: lineage AND regressed_qids non-empty. Note the ASYMMETRY of record: geometry regressions block on ANY packet carrying the three frozen qids regardless of decision count, while label regressions block ONLY at the pinned 65-row population.

modes.served_lineage: default: python -m evaluation.frozen_bars.run_bar_gates [--packet-dir ...]. Verifies the three served bundle shas against the accepted LABEL_HALF inputs BEFORE scoring; a mismatch is refused without a verdict.
modes.adjudicate: python -m evaluation.frozen_bars.run_bar_gates --adjudicate <packet-dir>. For a FUTURE packet on the three frozen qids. The served-bytes identity pin (a served-lineage provenance check, not a threshold) is not applied; observed shas are recorded instead. Same frozen rules, same incumbents, same predicates. Engine fidelity: the 33-cell GEOMETRY_HALF oracle comparison is a SERVED-LINEAGE check enforced only in served_lineage mode (an adjudicated packet legitimately differs cell-by-cell); adjudicate-mode records carry engine_oracle_check=served_lineage_only and engine fidelity is established once per execution by the default-mode run. Negative controls: the frozen injection battery is always required; the geometry hostile control is required whenever the qid lineage holds; the label blanked-evidence control is required when (and only when) the adjudicated packet's scored population equals the pinned 65 rows, because outside that population the frozen label regression predicate is NOT_APPLICABLE by construction; every non-required control outcome is still recorded, with a not_applicable reason, never dropped.

exit_codes.0: PASS_NO_REGRESSION — gates executed, no gate_blocks_build. In served_lineage mode this additionally certifies the served bytes are unchanged and the incumbents recompute exactly. In adjudicate mode it does NOT certify that the label bar was met; read the per-gate regression_verdict and absolute_status first.
exit_codes.1: FAIL_REGRESSION — at least one gate reported gate_blocks_build on the scored packet. Unreachable through served_lineage mode on any input (served bytes recompute the incumbent by construction; any drift exits 2 before scoring); reachable through adjudicate mode.
exit_codes.2: ENVIRONMENT_ERROR — rules sha mismatch, missing inputs, unknown qid (frozen anchor/lexicon refusal), served-byte drift in served_lineage mode, geometry engine-oracle divergence, or an unproven negative control. NOT a product verdict, NOT a regression, and never a pass.

naive_consumer_trap.state: adjudicate mode, exit 0, label regression_verdict NOT_APPLICABLE, gate_blocks_build false, n_supported 0
naive_consumer_trap.meaning: the packet's scored counter-label support is ZERO and the regression comparison did not apply because the population is not the incumbent 65 rows
naive_consumer_trap.falsifies: any consumer rule of the form 'exit==0 / gate_blocks_build==false => the packet met the counter-label bar'
naive_consumer_trap.required_reading: for packets outside the incumbent population, only absolute_status (LABEL_SOUND/UNSOUND, reported not enforced) says anything about label soundness; a packet-admission consumer that must not serve LABEL_UNSOUND packets has to test that field explicitly

reachability_of_record.served_lineage_exit_1: UNREACHABLE by construction (proven executably this run, run 38972887369: four byte-drift probe classes all exit 2; served execution exits 0)
reachability_of_record.adjudicate_exit_1_label: REACHABLE at the pinned 65-row population with blanked counter evidence (support 5 -> 0)
reachability_of_record.adjudicate_exit_1_geometry: REACHABLE on any three-frozen-qid packet whose criterion counts drop (e.g. hostile single stopword mega-cluster)
reachability_of_record.adjudicate_exit_0_with_zero_label_suppor: REACHABLE on a changed-population packet with blanked evidence (the naive-consumer trap above)
